title: Platform Transfer Request
description: Transfer between a wallet and a trading platform account owned by the authenticated client. The body is a strict whitelist - fields not listed here are rejected with 400.

Deriv-App-ID.description: Application identifier. Required for Personal Access Token (PAT) authentication; not required for OAuth Bearer tokens.

body.description: Send wallet_currency, exchange_rate and rate_token together, or none of them. Supplying one without the other two is rejected with 400.

wallet_id.description: Wallet on the wallet side of the transfer. Must belong to the authenticated client.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string, in currency. Any applicable fee is deducted from this amount.

currency.description: Currency of the platform account. Must match the account's actual currency.

direction.description: from_wallet debits the wallet to fund the platform account; to_wallet debits the platform account to fund the wallet.

platform_account_id.description: Login or account identifier on the platform. Must belong to the authenticated client and be a real account, not a demo one.

request_id.description: Idempotency key. Reusing a request_id you have already submitted is rejected with DuplicateRequestID.

description.description: Optional free-text note attached to the transfer.

wallet_currency.description: The wallet's currency. Send only for cross-currency platform transfers, when it differs from currency; exchange_rate and rate_token are then required too.

exchange_rate.description: Quoted exchange rate as a positive decimal string. Required together with rate_token when wallet_currency differs from currency.

rate_token.description: Token attesting to the quoted exchange rate. Required together with exchange_rate when wallet_currency differs from currency.
